properties.name: Evidence a value was fitted to cannot also count as that value's validation
properties.statement: When a value in the design was derived from a piece of evidence, the design must record what it was derived from, and must not let a check resting on that same evidence count as independent validation of it. Agreement with the anchor a value was fitted to is a fit, not a test, and must be reported as consumed. A capability whose only passing checks are consumed in this way must read as not independently verified. This cannot be computed from the strength of the evidence, only from its structure: no check internal to a design can establish its own independence, so the design must record the relation rather than attempt to detect the circularity.
